say:1:1721219001:1.text: A-Alright, alright! I'm done! I won't go in, I swear!
say:1:1721219001:1.source_cn: 别、别打了！我认输，我不进去找拉米尔就是了……

choice_prompt:2:1721219001.text: A-Alright, alright! I'm done! I won't go in, I swear!
choice_prompt:2:1721219001.source_cn: 别、别打了！我认输，我不进去找拉米尔就是了……

say:3:1721219002:1.text: I know, I know, I messed up! I lost my cool, that's all! It's just... a private dispute between me and Count Ramir. We can settle it ourselves!
say:3:1721219002:1.source_cn: 我、我错了，都是我一时昏了头。我只是……只是和拉米尔伯...

choice_prompt:4:1721219002.text: I know, I know, I messed up! I lost my cool, that's all! It's just... a private dispute between me and Count Ramir. We can settle it ourselves!
choice_prompt:4:1721219002.source_cn: 我、我错了，都是我一时昏了头。我只是……只是和拉米尔伯爵有一点小小的矛盾，我们私下里解决就好！

say:8:1721219005:1.text: Let me make something clear. What you just did is a crime.
say:8:1721219005:1.source_cn: 你要清楚，你刚刚的行为属于入室未遂，是犯法的。

say:9:1721219006:1.text: By law, I can arrest you right now and haul you back to the guard base in chains.
say:9:1721219006:1.source_cn: 依照律法，我完全有权将你就地逮捕，带回守备军驻地审讯判刑。

say:10:1721219007:1.text: No, please! D-Don't arrest me! I'm not the one who did wrong here!
say:10:1721219007:1.source_cn: 不、不要抓我！我、我是无辜的，错的又不是我！

say:11:1721219008:1.text: Then give me a reason to believe you. Right now all I have is a man trying to break down a stranger's door.
say:11:1721219008:1.source_cn: 口说无凭，我们不了解你行为的前因后果，凭什么相信你是无辜的？

say:12:1721219009:1.text: So here's your chance. Tell me why you came after Count Ramir.
say:12:1721219009:1.source_cn: 除非，你能给出一个合理的解释，说说你来找拉米尔伯爵的原因。

say:13:1721219010:1.text: If your story sounds reasonable, I may be willing to go easier on you.
say:13:1721219010:1.source_cn: 倘若真是情有可原，我可以考虑酌情减少对你的处罚。

say:15:1721219012:1.text: Only if you tell the truth.

say:17:1721219014:1.text: I made a decent fortune in trade. Thought maybe it was time to buy myself a title, a place among the nobles.
say:17:1721219014:1.source_cn: 我靠着做生意挣了些钱，就想着再买个爵位，以后家里也算是...

say:18:1721219015:1.text: I asked around. People said Ramir handled that sort of thing. So I took most of what I had and went to him.
say:18:1721219015:1.source_cn: 我找人打听，听说拉米尔伯爵在做这个生意。就拿了我大半的...

say:19:1721219016:1.text: He had no problem taking the money. After that, all I got were excuses and delays. By the time I realized what was going on, he was gone!
say:19:1721219016:1.source_cn: 可他收钱很快，爵位的事却一拖再拖！等我发现不对，他已经...

say:20:1721219017:1.text: Now I've got nothing. No title. No money. And who was I supposed to report it to? "Hello, officer, I was illegally trying to buy nobility"? I had nowhere else to go.
say:20:1721219017:1.source_cn: 我现在是权财两空，这事也没法找你们守备军……我实在没办...

choice_prompt:21:1721219017.text: Now I've got nothing. No title. No money. And who was I supposed to report it to? "Hello, officer, I was illegally trying to buy nobility"? I had nowhere else to go.
choice_prompt:21:1721219017.source_cn: 我现在是权财两空，这事也没法找你们守备军……我实在没办法，才只好过来找他算账……

say:23:1721219019:1.text: Go home. I'll look into Count Ramir. But if I catch you doing something like this again, I won't be so patient.
say:23:1721219019:1.source_cn: 你先走吧。拉米尔伯爵的事我会调查，但像今天的事，我不希...

say:25:1721219021:1.text: When he was pounding on the door, someone inside cried for help. She may know something. Let's ask.
say:25:1721219021:1.source_cn: 刚刚他砸门时，门中似乎有人在喊救命。或许她也是知情人…...
say:25:1721219021:1.male: When he was pounding on the door, someone inside cried for help. She may know something. Let's ask.
say:25:1721219021:1.female: When he was pounding on the door, someone inside cried for help. She may know something. Let's ask.

choice:21:0:1.text: So Grandet wasn't the only one who got scammed.
choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 类似霓光鲤的事，他不止干了一次
choice:21:0:1.male: So Grandet wasn't the only one who got scammed.
choice:21:0:1.female: So Grandet wasn't the only one who got scammed.

choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 看来还是个诈骗老手啊

choice:4:0:1.text: You said he scammed you. What was that about?
choice:4:0:1.male: You said he scammed you. What was that about?
choice:4:0:1.female: You said he scammed you. What was that about?

choice:4:1:2.text: By "private dispute," do you mean he scammed you too?
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 你说的矛盾，是他诈骗了你？
choice:4:1:2.male: By "private dispute," do you mean he scammed you too?
choice:4:1:2.female: By "private dispute," do you mean he scammed you too?

choice:2:0:1.text: Why were you trying to force your way into that house?
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 说，你为什么要私闯民宅？
choice:2:0:1.male: Why were you trying to force your way into that house?
choice:2:0:1.female: Why were you trying to force your way into that house?

choice:2:1:2.text: What do you want with Ramir?
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 你和拉米尔是什么关系？
choice:2:1:2.male: What do you want with Ramir?
choice:2:1:2.female: What do you want with Ramir?
